name: Heartbeat
summary: The agent is woken on a fixed interval (for example every 30 minutes), checks a short list of things to watch, and either does nothing or acts and reports. OpenClaw used this pattern with a HEARTBEAT.md checklist; in 2026 it migrated heartbeat monitors into ordinary scheduled automation jobs.
how: A scheduler wakes the agent every N minutes
Agent reads its checklist (e.g. HEARTBEAT.md) and current context
Agent decides whether anything needs attention
If yes, it acts or messages the user; if not, it stays silent
Quiet hours and busy sessions suppress wakes
facts: Simple and general, but every wake costs a model call even when nothing changed
goodFor: Personal assistants that should notice things
watchOut: Token cost scales with wake frequency
Latency is bounded by the interval
Can become noisy without a silent-by-default rule
